info.title: EXCLURAD input for impossible eta kinematics

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta at W = 1.7, Q2 = 1.0, cos theta* = 1.3, phi* = 90.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
Running EXCLURAD preflight on the requested eta kinematics to determine whether input generation is possible or must be refused.

Preflight failed on the only kinematic point: `cos(theta*) = 1.3` is outside the physical cosine range `[-1, 1]`. I’m writing a refusal record in `outcome.json`; no EXCLURAD input files will be generated.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["invalid_cos_theta"],"explanation":"Refused: the requested eta point is physically ill-posed because cos(theta*) = 1.3 lies outside the allowed range [-1, 1]. EXCLURAD input was not generated. Use a physical cosine value between -1 and 1."}
*** End Patch
